title: Bartosz Ciechanowski
creator: ciechanow.ski
description: Interactive, scrollable explainers of how physical things actually work.
note:
The best thing on the web, and it isn't close.

Each essay takes one topic — **gears**, **the GPS**, **light and shadow** — and builds a *playable* mental model of it. Every diagram is a live simulation you can drag.

- No ads, no newsletter popup, no "5 things"
- One post every few months because each takes *months*
- The [sailing one](https://ciechanow.ski/sailing/) finally made me understand how boats go upwind

It's what the web was supposed to be.
